# `cu_unrendered`

[Feature reference](0_home.md)

**Module:** core

**Kind:** node feature

## Description

1 where the edition printed `?°?` for this sign -- a sign it could not draw. The sign is on the tablet and occupies its slot; only the glyph is missing, so `cu_sign` is absent here for a reason that is a fact about the source, not a limit of the alignment. Set on the 2,347 such signs whose line aligned; `cu` holds 7,462 marks in all, the other 5,115 on the 3,601 lines that align at level 0 and so carry no per-sign values at all. What fails to render is a recognisable class: ad-hoc indices (`dan_x`), an unnormalised ASCII `h` for the corpus's `h-breve` (`ha`, `hu`), a Glossenkeil left in SimTex input form (`:ku`), and editorial text in the sign stream (`leer`, `erasure`).
